dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: It's always fun, no matter who I'm talking to!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: No matter who, you say? Such as?

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: I encountered a very beautiful crane once while washing radishes by a brook.

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: It had many colorful feathers, it was so pretty to look at.

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: I called out to it, and to my surprise, the crane could speak!

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: Hehe, well, let me give you some hints...

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: We really hit it off, and then we shared the shredded radish salad that I made... She also told me a lot of interesting stories.

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: Eventually, she declared that we had been fated to meet, and gave me Yuegui.

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: She made it using her very own mechanical arts, you know!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Oh, so was that Cloud Retainer?

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: Adeptus arts, mechanics... I'm really amazed by her many powerful and practical skills.

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: Let's go talk to her together sometime, shall we?

choices.text: Was that Cloud Retainer, by any chance?

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: Whoa, you got that without any hints! How did you guess?

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: I guess the term "smart cookie" was made just for you, huh? Nice one.

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: Aunty Cloud Retainer and I had a great time chatting, and then we ate the shredded radish salad that I made... She also told me a lot of interesting stories.

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: Eventually, she declared that we had been fated to meet, and gave me Yuegui.

response.speaker: Yaoyao
response.text: She made it using her very own mechanical arts, you know!
